The stored artifact is the canonical envelope: digest(payload) == artifact digest, and the envelope carries lineage, confidence and provenance under a strict bounded schema (findings counts bounded, undeclared fields refused). Validation findings are recorded as typed codes (terminal_code on the last attempt row, the run error code; a non-Passed qa_status is terminal) and for the model as readiness blockers (MODEL_SOURCE_LINEAGE_INCOMPLETE never READY). Lineage is recorded per artifact (lineage.upstream_digests differ between runs) and per build (source_lineage, one row per pinned source, changing when a source is removed while outputs do not). Caveat: confidence inputs (source_gate, qa_status, findings) are proven as envelope fields via the schema pin and the deterministic path; no retained test inspects the confidence recomputation inputs on a live agent artifact.

The run_budgets ledger persists limits, used, the in-flight reservation digest and the attempt ring. A reservation is recorded before any provider call (a failed reservation means zero calls), an unreconciled in-flight reservation survives a crash and fails closed on resume without re-spend, reconciliation commits the actual billed usage (used.output_tokens == 5000) before refusing the overage and clears the in-flight digest, reserve/reconcile/charge each apply exactly once under two-connection races, and budget.reserved/budget.reconciled log lines answer what a run has spent. The remaining ceiling is served as limits minus used from the persisted record rather than as a separate stored column.

UPDATE and DELETE on audit_events abort at the database boundary (APPEND_ONLY triggers; the SQLite and PostgreSQL DDL both exist and the legacy-table path re-arms them after backfill). The audit row rides the governed write's own transaction: an injected failure after the audit insert leaves no source, no source set, no promoted note, no snapshot, no pointer move and no audit row (acceptance rolls back snapshot, both pointers and audit as one unit), a refused duplicate appends nothing, and twelve concurrent governed writes extend one contiguous chain that verifies.

Missing sequence numbers: AUDIT_CHAIN_SEQUENCE_BROKEN on a deleted row (store) and on a reordered audit/events.jsonl (offline verifier); run-event seq is contiguous and unique under two writers. Duplicate terminal events: exactly one run.succeeded/run.failed after a normal run, after a crash in the commit gap and after fan-out failure reconciliation. Broken digest links: AUDIT_CHAIN_LINK_BROKEN, AUDIT_EVENT_DIGEST_MISMATCH and AUDIT_CHAIN_HEAD_MISMATCH convict mutate/insert/reorder/head tampering with the triggers disarmed. Impossible transitions: accepting a run whose node artifact is forged is RUN_NOT_READY, a stale or late resume is the typed RESUME_NOT_APPLIED, and every run-state event rides a conditional transition so zero rows updated mints no event.

No retained test asserts such a refusal and no mechanism exists to assert: audit_events has no foreign key to cases, actors or artifacts; _chain_key_for routes any non-empty case_id string to a chain, and an event without a case is accepted by design onto the global chain (the cited test proves that acceptance, not a refusal); actor, artifact and authority identifiers are free strings validated only for wire shape. Governed paths refuse an unknown case before they audit, but audit_event() itself accepts a nonexistent case, actor, artifact or authority. Missing: existence validation (or a foreign key) for case, actor, artifact and authority references at audit insert, a typed refusal, and a test.

With the wall clock injected to jump backward and forward, run-event order is the sequence (1..n) and never the clock, run.created stays first and the terminal event last, the recorded at-stamps are preserved exactly as observed (the jumps stay visible in the log), and active_minutes is charged from the monotonic clock and never negative. An hour parked at a human gate accrues zero active time while host compute and finalization are charged by the monotonic bracket. Audit rows are ordered by chain_seq, not at. Durations are the ledger's active_minutes, a quantity separate from the ISO at timestamps on events and audit rows.

Secrets and tokens: a provider failure whose message carries an API key persists neither the key nor evidence text in any of the run's serialized records; the audit package carries no session or edge secret, api_key or authorization string, and registered secrets are redacted from every log string. Provider error bodies: the faulting provider's body (with an embedded token and host) never reaches any persisted record, only the typed terminal_code; a renderer crash message never reaches the typed failed job. Rejected source text: every refused read leaves no text in rows, exception chain or ledger, and rejected module output is never logged. Hidden chain-of-thought: no provider response body is ever persisted (attempt rows carry a 64-hex response_digest and usage only; the package holds no prompt or messages body) and no adapter requests extended thinking, but no retained test targets a thinking block specifically.

Proven on an in-suite filed fixture case; no package has been exported from the frozen candidate stack (stack-gates: frozen 0, receipts 0).
